vscode-netron.onnxSimplification.enabled.description: Enable ONNX model simplification before viewing (reduces nodes and memory usage)

vscode-netron.onnxSimplification.pythonP.description: Path to Python executable (must have onnx and onnxsim packages installed)

vscode-netron.onnxSimplification.thresho.description: Minimum file size (MB) to trigger simplification

vscode-netron.rendering.viewportCulling.description: Enable viewport culling to render only visible nodes (improves performance for large graphs)

vscode-netron.rendering.chunkSize.description: Number of nodes to render per frame in progressive mode

vscode-netron.caching.enabled.description: Enable caching of parsed models for instant reloading

vscode-netron.onnxSimplification.sizeThr.description: Minimum model size in MB to trigger simplification

vscode-netron.onnxSimplification.largeMo.description: Size in GB above which to use large model simplification strategy

vscode-netron.onnxSimplification.skipOpt.description: List of optimizers to skip during simplification

vscode-netron.rendering.skipWeightData.description: Skip loading tensor weight data (reduces memory usage by 90-95%)

vscode-netron.rendering.progressiveRende.description: Enable progressive rendering for large graphs (renders in chunks to keep UI responsive)

vscode-netron.rendering.stringInterning.description: Enable string interning to reduce memory usage (saves 20-30% memory)

vscode-netron.caching.maxEntries.description: Maximum number of models to cache

vscode-netron.caching.maxSizeMB.description: Maximum total cache size in megabytes

vscode-netron.advanced.webWorkerParsing.description: Enable Web Worker for ONNX parsing (experimental - keeps UI responsive during parsing)

vscode-netron.advanced.lazyAttributeLoad.description: Load node attributes only when expanded (reduces memory and initial render time)

vscode-netron.streaming.enabled.description: Enable streaming parser for large models (Google Maps style loading)

vscode-netron.streaming.sizeThresholdMB.description: Enable streaming for models above this size in MB

vscode-netron.streaming.chunkSize.description: Nodes per chunk (smaller = less memory, more frequent loading)

vscode-netron.streaming.maxLoadedChunks.description: Maximum chunks to keep in memory (controls peak memory usage)

vscode-netron.streaming.prefetchDistance.description: Number of chunks to prefetch ahead for smooth scrolling

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
